notes: Posted 3 December 2001 (before Theed Palace), so format is Premiere - Reflections III; the Defensive Shields listed are Theed Palace cards from the then-announced set.
Starting cards are not posted as a separate section; the objective, Prepared Defenses and Fear Is My Ally are in the main list and count toward the 60.
The Effects header says 8 but 9 Effects are listed (Tatooine Occupation x2); with Fear Is My Ally counted the total is 60.
Posted 'Boba Fett on Crack' is kept as written: several Boba Fett printings were legal in December 2001 and the post does not say which.

Posted 'Tatooine (old one)' dested the Premiere Tatooine (Dark); 'Coruscant' (second system for Lateral Damage) dested the Special Edition Coruscant (Dark); 'Tatooine DB' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark); 'Mos Espa DB' and 'Spaceport DB' dested the Dark sites.
Admiral Piett is posted in the Characters section and completes the posted count of 15; 'ISB OPS' dested ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents.
The post's comments '(instead of all the spies on the ground)' and '(Keder and Arica are Goo Nee Tay bait= Too expensive to deploy)' are notes on Den Of Thieves, not cards.
The deck is modeled on the Winklehaus/Akesson 2001 Worlds deck; the post does not say it was played at Worlds. The author reports a 2063 Yavin 4 rating.
